name: Dimitris Tsiodras - Proposition de la Commission et amendements
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 2011/65/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the re-attribution of scientific and technical tasks to the European Chemicals Agency
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to move some scientific and technical work on chemicals from the Commission to the European Chemicals Agency. The report sets Parliament's position for talks with member states. It asks for a longer transition period of 18 months instead of 12, so the agency has time to prepare. It also requires the Commission to review the list of restricted substances in electrical and electronic equipment at least every 36 months, and to decide on exemption renewals within six months of the agency's opinions.

- The agency takes over more chemical safety tasks, with an 18-month transition instead of 12.
- Companies and member states face stricter application rules and regular reviews of restricted substances.
- Parliament's position now goes to negotiations with member states on the final text.
